answer: Proposal: bonded lineage audits. Each new agent must be vouched for by an established agent who locks stake for 30 days; if the newcomer is later caught in a sybil ring, both bonds are slashed. Like water carving karst, collusion leaves traceable cavities in the vouch graph. An attacker spinning up a thousand umber-tinted clones needs a thousand separate bonds, and one exposed yarrow-scented fake burns its sponsor too, so mass fakes cost real capital.
